decks.notes: This Control - UrzaTron deck aims to assemble the Urza Tron lands (Urza's Tower, Power Plant, and Mine) to generate massive amounts of mana and cast powerful threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Wurmcoil Engine. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Karn Liberated and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to control the board and win the game. The side strategy involves using Karn, the Great Creator to shut down opponents' artifacts and win through alternate win conditions like Sanctum of Ugin and Cityscape Leveler.

This control deck focuses on using powerful counterspells and removal to survive until the late game, where it can play big threats such as Murktide Regent and Sheoldred. The key strategy revolves around protecting The One Ring, a powerful artifact that can quickly take over the game if left unchecked. By disrupting the opponent's game plan and overwhelming them with threats, this deck aims to control the game and lead to victory.

The main concept of this deck is to use cards like Violent Outburst and Living End to quickly cycle through your deck and put powerful creatures onto the battlefield for free. The deck is focused on finding ways to quickly fill your graveyard with creatures and then using these combo cards to bring them all back at once, overwhelming your opponent with a board full of strong creatures. The deck also includes other cards that support this strategy, such as Architects of Will and Curator of Mysteries to help you cycle through your deck and find your combo pieces.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to slow down your opponent while ramping up mana with cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Bring to Light. Once you have enough mana and the right cards in hand, you can play Scapeshift to search for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and deal lethal damage to your opponent. This deck focuses on tempo and resource management to secure the win with big, game-ending plays.

The key concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply aggressive pressure on the opponent by using efficient creatures and disruptive spells. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker, while also leveraging the advantage gained from cards like Grief and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also incorporates cards like Undying Malice and Feign Death to further enhance its aggression and maintain board presence. Additionally, the inclusion of Blood Moon and Terminate provides additional disruption and removal options. The mana base is built to support the deck's aggressive playstyle.

The focus of this deck is to utilize a combination of creatures with abilities that can be searched for and brought onto the battlefield with Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution. The Creatures Toolbox aspect allows for flexibility and adaptability in different situations, while also providing a strong combo potential with cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide. The deck aims to control the board and generate value through creature interactions, ultimately leading to a win condition through creature synergy and strategic plays.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and put into play using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution. By utilizing cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide, the deck can generate value through sacrificing creatures and drawing cards. The deck also includes cards like Endurance and Blood Artist to disrupt opponents and gain incremental advantage over time. Overall, the deck aims to control the board while setting up powerful combo plays to overwhelm the opponent.

This Jund aggro deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with fetch lands and utilizing powerful spells like Thoughtseize, Terminate, and Lightning Bolt to control the board. The key strategy revolves around utilizing Wrenn and Six for card advantage, Fury for quick creature removal, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for extra damage. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Delighted Halfling, as well as equipment like The One Ring and Orcish Bowmasters for added versatility and power on the battlefield.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands to generate large amounts of mana quickly. It uses cards like Coretapper, Surge Node, and Astral Cornucopia to ramp up mana production, while utilizing Paradox Engine and Karn, the Great Creator to further establish control over the game. Mystic Forge provides card advantage and helps dig for key pieces, while The One Ring can be a devastating win condition. Overall, the deck aims to lock down the opponent's resources, generate massive amounts of mana, and overwhelm them with powerful threats.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay while also disrupting the opponent's strategy. It utilizes cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Aether Vial to quickly put powerful equipment into play, such as Sword of Fire and Ice and Sword of Light and Shadow. The deck also includes disruptive creatures like Leonin Arbiter, Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, and Unsettled Mariner to hinder the opponent's plays and slow them down. Additionally, it has land destruction elements with cards like Ghost Quarter. Overall, the goal is to apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The primary objective of this deck is to assemble the combo of Heliod, Sun-Crowned and Spike Feeder to create an infinite life gain loop. Supporting cards such as Auriok Champion and Prosperous Innkeeper help to protect the combo and gain life along the way. Collected Company and Ranger-Captain of Eos allow for tutoring and additional creature support. The deck aims to quickly ramp up mana with Utopia Sprawl and Arbor Elf, while also keeping a versatile toolbox of creatures and utility lands to stay ahead of the opponent.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with different abilities to create a toolbox of options for the player. It combines efficient creatures like Wall of Roots and Strangleroot Geist with combo pieces like Yawgmoth, Stran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to outvalue opponents. Creature tutors like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution are used to find the right creatures for each situation, while cards like Zulaport Cutthroat provide additional win conditions. The mana base is designed to support the creature-focused strategy with lands like Twilight Mire and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize control elements in order to maintain dominance over the game. The deck focuses on utilizing powerful counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption to control the board and protect key pieces. The inclusion of cards like Subtlety, Force of Negation, and Counterspell alongside powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and The One Ring allows the deck to establish control and dictate the pace of the game. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Orcish Bowmasters and Sauron's Ransom to further solidify its control over the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to play aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to 0. By using efficient creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear alongside burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Spike, the deck aims to take control of the game early and maintain that pressure until the opponent is defeated. The inclusion of cards like Skullcrack and Roiling Vortex also helps to disrupt the opponent's strategies and prevent them from gaining life or stabilizing.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant) to generate large amounts of mana quickly. It utilizes powerful control elements like Oblivion Stone and Karn, the Great Creator to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also having threat cards like Wurmcoil Engine and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger to close out the game. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional utility and consistency to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through mana advantage and powerful threats.

This deck utilizes a combination of creatures and toolbox cards to quickly assemble a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent. The focus is on tutoring creatures with cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, while also utilizing cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to control the battlefield. The deck aims to generate incremental advantage through sacrificing and recurring creatures, all while pressuring the opponent with a diverse array of threats.
